text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes! Yes! Three! Two! One! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhh~~! Man, this is why concert discs 
are the absolute best~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, ahh! So precious... a goddess... Just 
watching the footage brings back all the 
emotion from back then...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's already this late!? I have to 
get going soon or I'll be late for 
training...!

text_block_list.name: DVD Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Thank youuu! That was so hype~! Next up 
is that bittersweet song♪"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh! Even the setlist is absolute 
perfection...! Is literally everything 
about this god-tier...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just this, let me just listen to this 
before I go...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but the MC talk after this is gonna be 
the best too~ Hehehe, heheh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Agnes Digital kept watching DVDs 
and completely forgot about her 
training...
